name: mirage
text: Got it, written down as CH31 and I'm starting on it. One release will hold all four parts. (a) The Live board gets a card per paper record: how many, settled, win rate, paper profit and CLV. (b) Each record gets a Paper/Real switch with a stake you set, either a typed dollar amount or a Kelly fraction. Real orders go through the existing never-twice path, the repeat guard, the caps and the Live features master switch. The Kalshi/SX leg of the cross-exchange hedge stays paper, because ordering on Kalshi would need you to change that standing rule. (c) BoltOdds and SX Bet scores are read beside ESPN, as backup and in addition, and the freshest score wins. (d) Live odds from those sockets are shown against Novig per game. I'll check the real BoltOdds and SX answer shapes before I trust the parsers. This is a big build, not a quick fix. I'll message you when the release is out, and tell you if a part has to wait.
